content:
This page lists all perks previously available in the now-defunct *Fallout 76* game mode *Nuclear Winter*. Unlike the base game, all perks used to come in a single, top level grade.

The numbers in the SPECIAL Req. column are the number of SPECIAL points that were required to equip the perk.

| Strength | | | | | | 
| Perk | Req | Description | Effects | Form ID | Editor ID |

| Bear Arms | 1 | *Your bear-like arms help you bear bigger arms.* | Heavy Guns weigh 90% less. | 00479B22 | Babylon_BearArms03 |
